WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`job_name`, d_job.n), CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_job, COALESCE(concat(COALESCE(t.`job_name`, d_job.n), ' (', CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)) AS n_job, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`job_name`, d_job.n), CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`job_name`, d_job.n), CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_job FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.lakeflow_job_reliability t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(job_id AS STRING) AS job_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_job GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(job_id AS STRING)) d_job ON d_job.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_job.job_id = CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')))
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE status = 'CRITICAL') AS value,
       COALESCE((SELECT concat('Worst: ', nm_job, ', last ', CAST(consecutive_failures AS STRING), ' runs failed')
                 FROM r WHERE status = 'CRITICAL' ORDER BY consecutive_failures DESC LIMIT 1), 'None right now') AS target

WITH q AS (
SELECT CASE WHEN termination_code IN ('TIMED_OUT', 'TIMEDOUT') THEN 'Timed out'
            WHEN termination_code IN ('DRIVER_ERROR', 'CLUSTER_ERROR', 'DRIVER_UNREACHABLE', 'DRIVER_UNRESPONSIVE',
                                      'CLOUD_FAILURE') THEN 'Driver or cluster lost'
            ELSE 'Execution error' END AS bucket,
       COALESCE(termination_code, 'no code recorded') AS reason,
       SUM(run_rows) AS runs
FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_job.n, CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_job, COALESCE(concat(d_job.n, ' (', CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)) AS n_job, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(d_job.n, CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(d_job.n, CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_job FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.lakeflow_termination_taxonomy t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(job_id AS STRING) AS job_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_job GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(job_id AS STRING)) d_job ON d_job.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_job.job_id = CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING))
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')) AND COALESCE(termination_code, '') <> 'SUCCESS' AND upper(COALESCE(termination_code, '')) NOT LIKE '%CANCEL%'
GROUP BY 1, 2
),
r AS (SELECT `bucket` AS s, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(`runs`) DESC) AS rk FROM q WHERE `bucket` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `bucket`),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM r)
SELECT q.`reason`, q.`runs`,
       CASE WHEN q.`bucket` IS NULL OR r.rk < 8 OR n.n <= 8 THEN CAST(q.`bucket` AS STRING) ELSE 'Other' END AS `bucket`
FROM q LEFT JOIN r ON r.s = q.`bucket` CROSS JOIN n

SELECT r.status, r.n_job AS job, date_format(r.latest_run_start, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS latest_run,

LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.lakeflow_failed_jobs_wasted_dbus w ON w.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND w.job_id = r.job_id

datasets.name: 12b1cf0b
queryLines:
SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'lakeflow_job_reliability', 'Broken or flaky jobs', 'Failures'),
       (1, 'lakeflow_failed_jobs_wasted_dbus', 'Compute burned on failed runs', 'Failures'),
       (2, 'lakeflow_failed_runs', 'Failed job runs', 'Failures'),
       (3, 'lakeflow_never_started_runs', 'Runs that never started', 'Failures'),
       (4, 'lakeflow_succeeded_with_failed_tasks', 'Runs that \'succeeded\' with a failed task', 'Failures'),
       (5, 'lakeflow_termination_taxonomy', 'Termination reasons, reference', 'Failures'),
       (6, 'lakeflow_job_run_changes', 'What changed since the last good run', 'Failures'),
       (7, 'lakeflow_daily_state', 'Jobs and pipelines, day by day', 'Failures')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord

SELECT
  COALESCE(concat(n_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS `workspace_shown`,
  COALESCE(concat(COALESCE(t.`job_name`, n_job.n), ' (', CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`job_id` AS STRING)) AS `job_shown`,
  t.`status` AS `status`,
  t.`runs` AS `runs`,
  t.`failed_runs` AS `failed_runs`,
  t.`failure_rate_pct` AS `failure_rate_pct`,
  t.`runs_with_retry` AS `runs_with_retry`,
  t.`last_n_runs_considered` AS `last_n_runs_considered`,
  t.`last_n_failed` AS `last_n_failed`,
  t.`last_n_summary` AS `last_n_summary`,
  t.`consecutive_failures` AS `consecutive_failures`,
  date_format(t.`latest_run_start`, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS `latest_run_start`,
  t.`latest_result_state` AS `latest_result_state`,
  t.`latest_termination_code` AS `latest_termination_code`,
  t.`successful_runs` AS `successful_runs`,
  t.`p95_success_minutes` AS `p95_success_minutes`,
  t.`max_success_minutes` AS `max_success_minutes`,

SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'lakeflow_job_duration_regression', 'Jobs running slower than usual', 'Slow & queued'),
       (1, 'lakeflow_job_queue_time', 'Jobs waiting on compute', 'Slow & queued'),
       (2, 'lakeflow_phase_cold_start', 'Cluster cold-start time', 'Slow & queued'),
       (3, 'lakeflow_failed_cluster_starts', 'Failed cluster starts', 'Slow & queued'),
       (4, 'lakeflow_workload_mix_hours', 'Job workload by hour of day', 'Slow & queued'),
       (5, 'lakeflow_long_running_runs', 'Long-running runs', 'Slow & queued')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord

SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'lakeflow_job_compute_pressure', 'Job compute fit', 'Compute fit'),
       (1, 'task_cluster_utilization', 'Task-level cluster utilization', 'Compute fit'),
       (2, 'lakeflow_job_oversized', 'Jobs on bigger machines than they need', 'Compute fit')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord

# **Hygiene**
Lakehouse Health 03 - Jobs · List price (effective) · excludes your cloud VM bill

frame.title: Days covered
frame.description: Days in the snapshot. New numbers: run the notebook again.

frame.title: Jobs with no timeout
frame.description: No timeout_seconds set; Critical once the job has spent $200 or more in the window.

frame.title: Tasks with no timeout
frame.description: Same no-timeout check, one row per task inside a job.

frame.title: Health-rule coverage (%)
frame.description: Share of active jobs with at least 1 health rule configured.

frame.title: Ownership-risk jobs
frame.description: Critical: a scheduled job running as a person. Warn: a manual run-as-person, or no run-as recorded.

frame.title: Jobs relying on retries or repairs
frame.description: Repairs plus task retries plus retry runs; Warn at 5+, Critical at 20+; labeled job · workspace.

frame.title: Jobs on all-purpose compute, $
frame.description: List-price $ run on UI/API clusters instead of job clusters, after discount; labeled job · workspace.

frame.title: Stale jobs with no recent run
frame.description: Jobs with no run in 90+ days (30+ once the workspace has enough history).

## Every check on this page
Each check's own rows, worst first.

frame.title: Checks on this page
frame.description: Each check's verdict from the snapshot: Critical or Warn when any row is flagged, Not assessed when the check could not run (the reason is in the last column).

frame.title: Jobs relying on retries or repairs
frame.description: A job that only succeeds after an automatic retry or a manual repair run -- a reliability smell even when it eventually passes.

frame.title: Stale jobs with no recent run
frame.description: An active job with no run at all -- success or failure -- in a long time, or never; likely abandoned but still configured.

frame.title: Jobs with no timeout set
frame.description: A job with no timeout configured can run (and bill) indefinitely if it hangs.

frame.title: Job tasks with no timeout set
frame.description: Same risk as above, at the individual task level.

columns.title: Est. $ per job (shared cluster split evenly) ($)

frame.title: Jobs on all-purpose clusters
frame.description: Scheduled jobs running on interactive (all-purpose) pricing instead of cheaper job-cluster pricing.

frame.title: Jobs with no health rule
frame.description: A job with no configured health rule has nothing watching its run duration for you.

frame.title: Jobs with no clear owner
frame.description: A job whose creator/owner no longer looks active -- worth reassigning before it breaks unnoticed.

frame.title: Tasks running close to their timeout
frame.description: A task regularly finishing close to its configured timeout -- one slow day away from failing outright.

frame.title: Job cost summary, reference
frame.description: Per-job spend, for the job run panel; not a status check on its own. Reference list, not judged.

frame.title: Per-run cost, reference
frame.description: Per-run spend behind the job run panel; not a status check on its own. Reference list, not judged.

frame.title: Recent runs, reference
frame.description: Last N runs per job with duration and the failing task, behind the job run panel; not a status check on its own. Reference list, not judged.

frame.title: Tasks by bottleneck
frame.description: Task runs over 2 hours by bottleneck: memory, driver, I/O, CPU, skew, waiting/idle, or mixed.

frame.title: Flagged jobs, worst first
frame.description: Jobs with a Critical or Warn pressure signal, Critical first, worst memory p90 first.

frame.title: Jobs on oversized compute
frame.description: Oversized jobs (low CPU and memory at peak), worst possible saving first, after discount.
